title: Go: Diff Engine
description: Implement the Myers diff algorithm for line-by-line and word-level text diffs with unified format output.

steps.title: LCS table computation
steps.description: Implement `LCS(a, b []string) [][]int` that builds the Longest Common Subsequence length table using dynamic programming. Print the LCS length for `[]string{"a", "b", "c"}` and `[]string{"a", "c", "b"}` with `fmt.Println(table[len(a)][len(b)])`.
hints: The bottom-right cell holds the LCS length.

verification.failureMessage: Expected LCS length of 2 for 'abc' vs 'acb'.

steps.title: Edit script generation
steps.description: Using the LCS table, implement `Diff(a, b []string) []Edit` where `Edit` has `Op rune` (`' '`, `'-'`, `'+'`) and `Line string`. Backtrack through the table to produce the edit script. Print each edit line with `fmt.Printf("%c %s\n", e.Op, e.Line)`.
hints: If strings match → diagonal (keep); if from top → delete; if from left → insert.
Collect edits in reverse, then reverse the slice at the end.

verification.failureMessage: Check backtracking through the LCS table produces correct edits.

steps.title: Line-by-line diff with markers
steps.description: Format the edit script as a line-by-line diff with `+` and `-` markers. Implement `FormatEdits(edits []Edit) string` that produces a human-readable diff. Print the formatted diff for two short poems or text snippets.
hints: Prefix unchanged lines with `" "`, added lines with `"+"`, removed lines with `"-"`.
Join with `\n` to produce the final string.

verification.failureMessage: Ensure format includes '+' for additions and '-' for deletions.

steps.title: Unified diff format
steps.description: Generate unified diff output: `@@ -start,count +start,count @@` header followed by context lines. Add 3 lines of context around changes. Print the unified diff for two multi-line strings.
hints: Group edits into hunks with surrounding context.
Context lines (unchanged) appear before and after each change cluster.

verification.successMessage: Unified diff format with hunk headers works.
verification.failureMessage: The diff must include @@ hunk headers with line numbers.

steps.title: Patch application
steps.description: Implement `ApplyPatch(original []string, edits []Edit) []string` that applies the edit script to the original text and returns the result. Verify that `ApplyPatch(a, Diff(a, b))` equals `b`. Print `"patch applied"` on success.
hints: Apply edits in reverse order (bottom-up) to preserve line indices.
For deletions, remove the line; for insertions, add the line at position.
After application, compare with expected using `reflect.DeepEqual`.

verification.failureMessage: ApplyPatch should transform 'a' into 'b' using the edit script.

steps.title: Word-level diff
steps.description: Adapt the algorithm for word-level diff. Split text `"hello world foo"` into words with `strings.Fields`. Compute word-level edits and display them using `fmt.Printf("[-%s-] [+%s+]", oldWord, newWord)` for changed words.
hints: Split both strings by whitespace using `strings.Fields`.
Run the same Diff algorithm on the word slices.
Group consecutive word edits into phrases for readable output.

verification.failureMessage: Word diff should show deletions with [- -] and additions with [+ +].
